diagnosis.genericMasterHeader: DetectSkillContentId took the first exact dictionary row. Every panel beginning with the generic '[Master Level: 20]' segment resolved to 1200000, so Rush, Critical Recovery, Sword Booster and Slow could borrow Sword Mastery's or another skill's description; Arrow Bomb borrowed Drain.
diagnosis.containedName: DetectUniqueSkillNameId now records every whole-name occurrence with its start and length, discards only shorter occurrences contained inside a longer occurrence, and keeps independently positioned names in the ambiguity set. 'Magic Guard Recovery' and 'Critical Recovery Recovery' therefore return no arbitrary id, while 'Critical Recovery' remains 4100002.
diagnosis.cloudReviewR2toR7: The second review found five further unsafe paths: a known id could replace negated/unrelated prose; an untranslated current effect was erased when the header succeeded; a proportional split inside one OCR word could become measured; a distant list header could authorize a player name; 'at most' was rendered as 'at least'; and coverage counted only master-prefixed rows. Each is addressed below and covered by regressions.
diagnosis.cloudReviewR2a: The third review found three remaining visible-semantics failures: an appended 'and fly' was still covered by a percentage threshold; 'unless using a sword' matched a 'when using a sword' candidate because both were condition words; and '-10' became '+10' because Normalize discarded the minus before numeric checks. The fix uses complete ordered content coverage, relation-specific condition signatures and raw sign/value/unit/attribute facts checked before any Normalize; the same guard is shared by dictionary candidates and the full-text fallback.
diagnosis.cloudReviewR2b: The fourth review found that the shared ContentTokens stop list deleted meaningful logic/direction/scope words. 'and' vs 'or', 'up' vs 'down' and 'all' vs 'some' now participate in ordered coverage and are protected from OCR fuzzy matching. Relation, direction and object scope are therefore part of source/candidate and condition-scope matching; both directions are negative-tested through the production plan and composition.
diagnosis.sectionOwnership: The old AddSkillPanelLabels ranked at most three long-text candidates, let the body union include the master and prerequisite rows, and the independent overview/effect passes could add competing owners for the same panel. A successful section could suppress or overlap another.
diagnosis.listNames: The main dictionary pass called FindSkillNameMatches on every ordinary line, so a bare skill name in prose or a player name could be replaced outside a skill list. Trailing level digits had no protected span.

implementation.identity: Maximal exact skill-name spans are resolved first. A unique visible body is the second source of identity. The generic '[Master Level: N]' row never resolves an id. Contained short names do not create ambiguity, and a shared Chinese body is used only when every candidate supplies the identical Chinese; otherwise the original body is preserved.
implementation.onePanelPlan: BuildSkillPanelPlan creates one SkillPanelPlan per visible panel. It owns name, master level, description, prerequisite, current and next as separate sections with exact source spans. One section cannot suppress another; absent sections are not invented; a failed section is preserved without blocking the others.
implementation.numericSafety: SkillOverviewSafety validates every overview candidate and the full-text fallback against the observed sentence: ordered complete content coverage with one-character whole-token OCR tolerance, negation, relation-specific conditions and scope, restriction classes, attribute set, and numeric facts. Logic/direction/scope tokens (and/or, up/down, all/some, with/from/into, user/party/member, ...) are never deleted and are protected from OCR fuzzy matching. Raw sign/value/unit/attribute facts are checked before any Normalize. Exact dictionary sentences use a multiset of visible numbers (human Chinese may reorder clauses); templates and approximate borrowings use attributed numerators. Unsafe means the original pixels are preserved. Level effects keep ordered numeric preservation.
implementation.conditionSafety: Condition marker, relation and clause scope are compared as a signature. when/unless and before/after are distinct; the Chinese target must carry the matching relation and the associated weapon/scope evidence. Scope content is covered in both directions.
implementation.rawNumerics: RawNumberFacts reads the original text before Normalize. It preserves sign, canonical value, unit and the associated HP/MP/damage attribute; target Chinese may express negativity as 减少/降低 but must keep the same signed value and unit. Every dictionary candidate and the vocabulary fallback call the shared guard.
implementation.overviewSafety: SkillOverviewSafety.cs is a shared gate used by TryGetVisibleSkillOverviewBody, TryTranslateSkillOverview, TryResolveSharedSkillContent and IsSafeFallback. It never chooses an id; it can only accept or reject a translation for a supplied/verified id.
implementation.headerEffectSplit: When a current/next effect cannot be translated, only a measured header span is replaced. The effect pixels stay original. The plan records headerStatus and effectStatus separately (planned/painted/preserved), so a successful header cannot stand in for a preserved effect.
implementation.measuredConfidence: SkillTextRow carries Measured and Synthetic. Every split receives the source boundary confidence; a synthetic row is built from word-level slices so a header/effect split at real word boundaries stays measured, while a proportional split inside one word stays estimated. AddSpanRows ANDs the confidence. Final labels refuse !Measured; estimated labels are not promoted by wrapping or slot expansion.
implementation.requiredRelation: ParseRequiredSkillCondition parses the complete prerequisite relation: plain level, at least, at most and common OCR spellings. Unsupported relations preserve the original row instead of defaulting to '至少'. A name that is absent or ambiguous also preserves it.
implementation.listLocalContext: SkillNameListPolicy requires the title, candidate row and neighbouring name rows to be in one local region. A header in another panel, a same-column but far row, or a standalone player name cannot authorize a replacement.
implementation.combinedRows: SplitSkillSemanticRows separates title, master header, body, prerequisite, current and next when they share one OCR line. Splits use word-level slices where possible. A proportional split inside one OCR word is marked estimated and never upgraded to measured, applied, planned or painted.
implementation.typography: SkillPanelTypography is shared: SimSun, GraphicsUnit.Pixel, body floor 11px, body cap 16px, title body+3 with a narrow-name readable fallback. Section slots expand only into blank space before the next measured section. There is no per-section 8px shrink loop.
implementation.composition: SimpleFusionComposition uses the plan's fixed pixel size, refuses a section that does not fit, and records skill-panel/skill-paint status. Generic overview/effect passes skip panels owned by the plan.

coverage.denominatorRule: One primary visible overview per id: Henesys.gg current, then full site, then a prose segment. A [Master Level] prefix is not required. All other visible variants are listed as supplemental, not counted as absent.
